messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change, explaining how rising temperatures affect ecosystems, weather patterns, and human societies. |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original film, this sequel examines progress (or lack thereof) since 2006, highlighting new scientific findings and policy developments. |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change firsthand, interviewing scientists, activists, and leaders while discussing solutions. |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A concise, data‑driven overview that explains the science behind global warming, its consequences, and potential mitigation strategies. |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film features interviews with environmental experts and explores the ecological crisis caused by human activity. |

All of these films are available on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or can be rented/bought on iTunes, Google Play, or YouTube Movies. If you’d like more details on a specific documentary—such as runtime, availability, or critical reception—just let me know!
